name: Canadian Salad
description: Canadian Salad is a North American compendium trick-taking game where six hands are played in sequence with different objectives. In each hand, players try to avoid winning certain cards or tricks that bring penalty points. Also known as Wisconsin Scramble.

content.text: Canadian Salad is a North American compendium trick-taking game where six hands are played in sequence with different objectives. In each hand, players try to avoid winning certain cards or tricks that bring penalty points. Also known as Wisconsin Scramble.

Canadian Salad is a North American compendium game, best known in Canada but also played under other names such as Wisconsin Scramble in other parts of North America. The compendium format (multiple hands with different objectives) is common in European games like Barbu and Herzeln.
